context.transcript:
Hi, Joseph.
You know how a store does those workshops on home improvements?
Well, I'm supposed to lead one next month, but it turns out I have to go out of town.
Well, I could do it for you.
I'm finishing up a series of workshops on bathroom remodeling this month, so I'll have more time then.
What's the topic of the workshop?
It's about how to install light fixtures in your home.
A lot of our customers are interested in that.
Okay, sure.
But I haven't done that kind of workshop before.
I'm not sure what materials I'll need.
Don't worry.
I'll get all the materials ready so you'll have them beforehand.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Joseph。
你知道商店那种关于家居装修的讲习班吗？
嗯，我下个月本来要主持一个，但结果我要出差了。
我可以帮你做这个。
我这个月正在完成一系列浴室翻修的讲习班，到时候我有更多时间。
讲习班的主题是什么？
是关于如何在家里安装灯具的。
我们很多客户对这个很感兴趣。
好的，没问题。
但我以前没有做过这种类型的讲习班。
我不确定我需要哪些材料。
别担心。
我会把所有材料准备好，让你提前拿到。
